Name: Auto Load Save
Author: PapyRoach
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Auto Load Save gets you back to your farm faster. Tick a save in the Load menu, and from then on the game loads it as soon as it starts: no title screen, no logo, no intro, no clicking through menus. Hold Shift while the game starts whenever you want the title screen instead.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. You should end up with Mods/AutoLoadSave/AutoLoadSave.dll.
3. Run the game through SMAPI and open the Load menu.
4. Tick the box under the number of the save you want, on the left of its slot.
5. Next time you launch the game, that save loads straight away.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- One checkbox per save in the game's own Load menu. Only one save can be ticked at a time, and clicking the ticked box again turns auto-load off.
- The ticked save loads as soon as the game is ready, exactly like picking it in the Load menu, so it opens in single-player as usual.
- Waits for the game to apply your language before loading, so your save always opens in the right language.
- Hold Shift while the game starts to skip auto-load and get the title screen for that session. The key can be changed in config.json (SkipKey).
- Auto-load only happens once per launch: going back to the title screen from your save keeps you on the title screen.
- If the ticked save has been deleted, the game just shows the title screen as usual and a warning is written in the SMAPI log.
- Hover the checkbox for a short reminder of what it does.
- Translated into English and French.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later.
- SMAPI 4.1.0 or later.
- No other mod needed.
- Co-op: only saves from the Load menu can be ticked. Saves you join as a farmhand (Co-op menu) are not affected.
